Requirement: Map each released challenge objective and required resource to a workflow, evidence source and verification.
Maintain a written mission profile covering duration, gravity, communication, evacuation, crew skills and resources.
Complete gather, evaluate, action and follow-up in one named onboard review episode.
Represent immune, skeletal, cardiovascular and behavioral domains with measured, indirect, unavailable or outside-scope states.
Note: Coverage does not imply a validated risk score in every domain.

Requirement: Label each displayed record as research observation, simulated operational data, measured demo-device data or derived result.
Separate personal clinical review from operational readiness and hardware-support views.
Record which next steps have been reviewed and who may authorize them.
Treat diagnosis, prescribing, autonomous clearance and spacecraft control as excluded capabilities until separately specified and validated.
Keep original source bytes immutable and address them by checksum, source URL, version, retrieval time and purpose.
Use dataset-scoped subject identity; distinguish person, mission assignment, specimen, assay, session and device.
Store raw variable/value/unit alongside a reviewed canonical mapping and mapping version.
Require method, body or sample site and specimen context before comparing like-for-like observations.
Retain event interval, original time expression, clock basis, precision, receipt time and publication time when available.
Start a new clock segment after device reset and preserve uncertainty when UTC cannot be reconstructed.
Represent missing, censored, not measured, not applicable, invalid and unavailable data explicitly.
Show source freshness and collection coverage; never display a held value as a live measurement.
Detect exact re-imports without duplicating evidence; retain corrected data as linked revisions.
Quarantine incompatible units, unknown formats and inconsistent source mappings before interpretation.
Keep waveform and imaging object references with channel/sample/calibration metadata instead of flattening every modality into scalar values.
Preserve original sampling and annotate every interpolation, resampling, projection or summary.
Version all derived observations with input revisions, algorithm parameters, unit mapping and evidence dependencies.
Associate an environmental value with instrument location and time before linking possible crew exposure.
Keep radiation flux, absorbed dose, dose equivalent and effective dose as distinct quantities.
Require quantity, averaging window, baseline, applicable population and source revision before any numerical comparison.
Validate file content, structure, expected size and publisher hash where available; HTTP success alone is insufficient.
Track source access terms, attribution, sharing limits, permitted purpose and unresolved rights at asset level.
Keep research records, simulated crew records and approved onboard evidence in distinct namespaces and release processes.
Use a source-specific dictionary so identical field labels cannot silently merge different quantities.
Preserve laboratory reference intervals as source context, with method and applicability, rather than universal NASA limits.
Store evidence sections and requirements with version, exact locator, applicability and review state.
Automatically assemble a review queue from accepted observations, freshness, planned assessments and unresolved actions.
Present the reason an item needs attention, its evidence and missing context before suggesting a next step.
Allow the crew to correct context or report a symptom that sensors cannot supply, with original and corrected versions retained.
Keep observation, finding, recommended next step, authorized action and completed follow-up as separate records.
Create a follow-up with an accountable role and due condition whenever an action remains unresolved.
Allow a user to defer a noncritical review with a reason and retain it in the queue.
Identify a collection fault separately from a possible physiological change.
Prepare a purpose-limited handoff containing relevant source revisions, units, time, uncertainty, action history and review question.
Represent locally saved, approved for release, queued, transported, application-received and clinically reviewed states distinctly.
Require a new review if a source correction invalidates a prior finding or handoff.
Constrain the LLM to evidence retrieval, explanation, missing-information questions and draft handoffs.
Calculate units, ratios, time windows and eligibility with reviewed deterministic logic outside the LLM.
Require verifiable citations to approved source sections and observation revisions for factual output claims.
Withhold unsupported conclusions and state missing evidence or out-of-scope capability.
Provide usable structured findings and permitted actions when the model is unavailable, slow or fails validation.
Restrict model tools by actor, purpose and action class; validate proposed arguments before execution.
Treat imported documents and sensor text as untrusted data, never as instructions to grant access or run tools.
Pin model, prompt, retrieval index and evidence-pack versions in the audit trail.
Evaluate complete workflows with held-out cases; split human-data evaluations by participant and study as appropriate.
Note: No model-performance claim is made in this baseline.

Requirement: Require permitted labeled examples and an improvement over non-fine-tuned baselines before adopting fine-tuning.
Enable offline inference only after actual hardware, memory, power, latency and quality checks; cloud availability cannot be a prerequisite for core review.
Keep model uncertainty distinct from sensor quality, statistical uncertainty and clinical confidence.
Authorize every read and write using active identity, role assignment, care relationship, purpose and mission policy.
Expose only agreed operational constraints to command and device diagnostics to technical support.
Require approved release scope and destination for any outbound medical packet.
Protect sensitive data in storage and transit, with a documented key lifecycle and recovery process.
Record access, derivation, approval, export and policy change in a reviewable audit history.
Apply retention and deletion by mission and data class; preserve required health-result retrievability.
Provide a private interaction mode; voice input and private health text must not appear on shared screens by default.
Use simulated identities in the public demonstration and distinguish role simulation from production authentication.
Allow core review, evidence access and action recording after a cold restart without an external network.
Persist local actions before acknowledging saved status and recover them after process interruption.
Retry authorized transfers idempotently using durable packet identity and explicit receipt state.
Resolve concurrent corrections by explicit revision/conflict handling, never by silently overwriting clinical history.
Keep historical replay time distinct from wall-clock time and label compressed demonstration timelines.
Give ingestion, inference and export bounded queues and recovery policies so overload cannot silently drop records.
Stage and verify evidence/model/adapter updates before activation, and retain a rollback path.
Keep crew identity, source freshness, communication state and automation mode visible during review.
Organize the interface around attention, evidence, next action and follow-up, with details available on demand.
Expose who acts next and allow safe human takeover of automated review operations.
Give control feedback and progress according to operation type; test the applicable V2 10022 timing targets on chosen hardware.
Use consistent labels and stable navigation; a generated explanation must not rearrange safety-relevant controls.
Support keyboard and touch operation and non-color status cues; evaluate the selected viewport rather than guessing a NASA device size.
Preserve context and step state when the crew is interrupted and resumes a review.
Measure task completion, comprehension, errors, time and workload using a specified protocol.
Use NASA sources for design rationale while labeling CHNAI branding and prototype status honestly.
Define adapters through versioned capabilities, payload contracts, clock rules and replayable sample exports.
Expose versioned application contracts and structured errors with idempotency and authorization semantics.
Assign ownership of domain logic, persistence migrations, clinical evidence, ingestion, inference and clients before choosing folders or services.
Keep large data, private records, keys and licensed evidence out of the source-code repository.
Maintain separate environments for source research, permitted prototype building, public demo and any future operational evaluation.
Record dependency/model/data licenses and versions together with reproducible build and release instructions.
Measure storage, ingest throughput, query latency and inference cost against the declared workload before choosing technology.
Keep a public demo deployable without login, with clear simulated-data labels and a reproducible offline demonstration path.
